text_block_list.text:
Only the best racers worthy of being
part of the
Ultimate Era have gathered
to compete in the
Arima Kinen, which
marks the climax of Eishin
Flash's
three-year career.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As Эйсин Флэш remarks that winning first
place
today would cap her career off on
the perfect
note, I interrupt her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The schedule I cobbled together for her
is sloppy
at best, but it's filled with my
intense hope that
she'll keep racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To my great relief, Эйсин Флэш is already

determined to keep running. She gladly
offers to
make adjustments to the plan
after the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
